mapper.update: UPDATE run SET status = 'paused', pause_kind = #{param3}, pause_reason = #{param4}, paused_at = now(), pause_node_key = #{param5}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND status = 'running'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manual_window (tenant_id, run_id, window_key, error_code, node_key, strategy, default_action, allowed_actions, decision_reason, status, timeout_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, 'EC-HUMAN-WAIT', #{param4}, 'manual', 'MANUAL', '["CONTINUE","RETRY","SKIP","ABORT","MANUAL"]'::jsonb, #{param5}, 'pending', now() + interval '1 hour')
mapper.update: UPDATE manual_window SET status = 'decided', decided_at = now(), decided_by = #{param3}, decided_action = #{param4}, note = 'run resumed/closed' WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND run_id = #{param2} AND status = 'pending'
DELETE FROM position_state WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND reserved_by_run = #{param2} AND plate_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(block_reason, '') <> 'PLATE_UNKNOWN'
DELETE FROM resource_booking WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND status = 'active' AND COALESCE(release_exempt, false) = false AND run_node_id IN (SELECT id FROM run_node WHERE run_id = #{param2})
UPDATE device_port_usage u SET in_use = 0, updated_at = now() WHERE u.tenant_id = #{param1} AND u.port_id IN (SELECT id FROM device_port WHERE tenant_id = #{param1}) AND u.in_use > 0

UPDATE run SET status = 'aborted'::run_status, pause_kind = NULL, resumed_at = now(), error_code = COALESCE(error_code, 'EC-HUMAN-ABORT'), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}

UPDATE run SET status = 'aborted', pause_kind = NULL, pause_reason = NULL, pause_node_key = NULL, actual_end = now(), error_code = COALESCE(error_code, 'EC-HUMAN-DISMISS'), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND status = 'paused'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO position_evidence (tenant_id, plate_barcode, evidence_type, run_id, operator, note) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, 'MANUAL', #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5})

INSERT INTO plate_location_audit (tenant_id, barcode, from_status, to_status, actual_location, operator, note, run_id) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, #{param6}, #{param7}, #{param8})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS "runId", r.run_no AS "runNo", r.pause_kind AS "pauseKind", r.pause_reason AS "pauseReason", r.paused_at AS "pausedAt", r.pause_node_key AS "pauseNodeKey", n.name AS "nodeName", n.status::text AS "nodeStatus", n.input->>'reason' AS "nodeReason" FROM run r LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT n2.name, n2.status, n2.input FROM run_node n2 WHERE n2.run_id = r.id AND n2.level = 0 AND n2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'skipped') ORDER BY n2.id LIMIT 1) n ON true WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.status = 'paused' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.paused_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT p.barcode AS "barcode", p.position_status AS "positionStatus", COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(r.code ORDER BY r.id) FROM resource_node r WHERE r.id = ANY(p.possible_locations)), '{}') AS "locationNames", p.possible_locations AS "locationIds" FROM plate p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.position_status IN ('UNKNOWN','LOST') ORDER BY p.barcode LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE run SET status = 'running', pause_kind = NULL, pause_reason = NULL, resumed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND status = 'paused' AND pause_kind = 'paused_fault' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM device_state ds JOIN workflow_node wn ON wn.tenant_id = ds.tenant_id AND wn.resource_id = ds.resource_id WHERE ds.tenant_id = run.tenant_id AND ds.online = false AND wn.workflow_id = run.workflow_id)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pause_request (tenant_id, request_id, target_type, target_id, action, source, kind, reason, requested_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{requestId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{action}, #{source}, #{kind}, #{reason}, #{requestedBy}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT result_state AS "resultState", kind AS "kind", result_detail AS "resultDetail" FROM pause_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pause_event (tenant_id, request_id, event_type, target_type, target_id, scope, payload) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{requestId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{eventType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{scope, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payloadJson}::jsonb)
